forecast_checkpoint: First healthy observation at 570–600 seconds remaining; common checkpoint; all 96 scheduled slots/day required for favorable holdout review. No missing-period zero returns.
primary_exit: Official settlement only; no learned exit strategy.
holdout_policy: Final outcomes withheld by default report until release. No parameter tuning or primary reselection. Changes require a new future study; no automatic reset or promotion.
comparison_policy: Market midpoint is price-implied probability only; never assumed executable. Always abstain has zero trading return. Ablations are exploratory, never selected for promotion from these results.
risk_policy: One-unit hypothetical experiments only. Personalized sizing requires user risk budget, maximum loss and constraints.

uncertainty.method: non-circular moving consecutive UTC-day blocks; resample then truncate to original length
uncertainty.acceptance: Every block-length stress lower bound >0 and paired Brier upper bound <0. Intersection of sensitivity tests, not simultaneous 95% confidence. Eight nonoverlapping weeks is still limited; stationarity not guaranteed.

clock_policy.request_start: UTC seconds sampled immediately before GET dispatch, no rounding
clock_policy.origin: persisted completed initial observation epoch t0
clock_policy.execution: first successful serial observation with book dispatch >=t0+15 and observation completion <=t0+35; no price selection
clock_policy.duplicate_policy: reject duplicate/out-of-order observation; unique UTC opening slot; ambiguous discovery fails closed
clock_policy.retries: client transport does not retry; failed collection produces a gap, subsequent poll may qualify within original window; initial signal never replaced
clock_policy.restart: Persist observation UTC and monotonic epochs. Reject clock discontinuities across polls/restarts, including reboot or suspend discontinuities; no silent reset.

missing_policy: Fixed 900-second UTC slots; one unique active KXBTC15M contract per slot. No calendar deletions. Missing checkpoint, invalid source, outage or canceled/nonbinary outcome prevents favorable review. No restart budget, imputation, backfill or zero-return assumption for missing slots.

fee_policy.scenario: one taker fill per consumed displayed level; order-local rounding accumulator; no maker fees or settlement fees
fee_policy.acceptance: Maximum of legacy conservative level fees and both account-precision bounds: split consumed quantity into .01 units, ceil each unit model fee to six decimals, ceil each unit all-in debit to balance precision, assume no rebates. Subadditivity of ceilings bounds all allowed groupings at displayed prices. Unknown account precision prevents a favorable one-unit profitability conclusion under this bound.
fee_policy.activation_requires: fresh official schedule and KXBTC15M series verification plus minimum fill quantity verification; incompatible rules block study

outcome_policy.rule: append every observed finalized public result; conflicting/nonbinary/revoked final status quarantines contract permanently; no overwrites of original result; pre-release recheck required; no final outcomes queried by report before release

approval_policy.binding: SHA256 release_manifest.json; approved_at precedes start; approval does not enable advice
approval_policy.late_approval: reject; prepare separately reviewed future-dated protocol, never shift automatically

fee_evidence_policy: Observed historical fee agreement is not membership classification or permission to narrow acceptance costs. Both precision scenarios and existing conservative acceptance remain unchanged. Historical reconciliation is offline, pre-study, complete-terminal-order taker-only, and excluded from strategy evaluation.
